messages:
tom_sales: Heads-up: Lucas from FinFlow hitting POC errors on embeddings->rerank pipeline. Bringing in eng/support. @priya_eng @anand_ml @maya_support
lucas_customer: getting a bunch of 400s and 429s. Rerank fails with "incompatible vector size" after some batches. We're using an internal alias 'finflow-embed' that should map to redwood/semantic-1536 but we've been testing with mini-512 as a speed optimization.
priya_eng: can you paste the exact error snippet and which endpoint called (embeddings vs rerank)? Also tell us the model id sent to the API (alias vs explicit).
lucas_customer: error: "400 Bad Request: expected vector dim 1536 but received 1024". We call /v1/embeddings via our wrapper which supplies model: finflow-embed. We also see 429 spikes when we run parallel batch jobs (k6 load test).
anand_ml: interesting — 1024 is not 512 or 1536. Could be a quantized mid-size model or an internal transform. Two likely causes: alias points to a different model than doc says, or client-side encoder has a dimension-mix due to multiple encoder versions across hosts.
maya_support: logs from our side show bursts of concurrent embedding requests from org acct-FF76: peak ~420 req/s for 45s -> returned 429 with Retry-After. We also logged several rerank errors at the same time: "batch validation failed: dim mismatch".
tom_sales: customer asked if we can temporarily raise POC rate limits to let them finish validation. Is that doable?
priya_eng: ops can bump POC quota for 24-72h but we should fix the mismatched dims first or they'll waste the quota. Quick debug steps for Lucas: 1) curl direct to Redwood to confirm model mapping, 2) run a single-host encoder check to ensure uniform vector sizes, 3) add client-side validation before sending batches.
lucas_customer: running direct curl now.
redwood-bot: infra: policy-change applied for org acct-FF76 (no downtime)
lucas_customer: curl result: embedding vector length = 1024. So the alias is pointing to an intermediate model (we have a legacy mapping).
anand_ml: ok that explains it. For reranker we require homogeneous dims. Mixed dims in the same batch crash the reranker (we don't silently pad). For a safe POC: either update the alias to semantic-1536 or switch reranker to a 1024-compatible variant. Recommend switching alias for parity with docs.
priya_eng: for the rate issue we recommend client changes: limit concurrency and add exponential backoff. Example patch: // recommended POC client config
const batcher = new Batcher({
  maxConcurrent: 6,
  maxBatchSize: 12,
  retry: { attempts: 5, backoffMs: 250 }
});

maya_support: we can also enable a temporary org-level rate increase. Tom, if you approve we'll open support ticket and add +2x headroom for 48h.
tom_sales: approve — please open ticket and include sample logs and timeline. Lucas, want to avoid flipping quota without fixing alias; please change alias first and re-test.
lucas_customer: changing alias now to point to redwood/semantic-1536. will test in ~15m. Also flagged a security question from our InfoSec: where are embeddings stored and are they encrypted at rest?
maya_support: embeddings: by default hosted embeddings are transient and not persisted long-term unless "persist" or "cache" is enabled. All data at rest in storage tiers is encrypted (AES-256) and SOC2 controls cover access. We'll send the security FAQ paragraph.
anand_ml: one more gotcha: if some client hosts still send 1024 vectors while others send 1536, reranker batch validator will reject the whole batch. Suggest adding a pre-send validation: drop or route mismatched items to separate batch and return partial results for POC. We're preparing a small helper function for the SDK.
priya_eng: created a small PR with validator + CLI tool to scan your encoded vectors: https://github.com/redwood/clients/pull/499 (includes a node script to check dims and a flag --allow-partial for graceful POC behavior).
tom_sales: thanks. Summary of next steps: 1) Lucas to update alias -> explicit 1536 model (target today), 2) Support to open ticket and bump POC headroom for 48h, 3) Anand/priya to drop validator patch and usage notes into customer's repo, 4) Support to send security paragraph. I'll follow up with an email and attach the ticket. :thumbsup:
lucas_customer: alias switched, re-running tests now. thanks team.
priya_eng: if you still see 429s after reducing concurrency, paste the exact Retry-After header and we'll consider a longer bump.
maya_support: support ticket #4678 opened, attached logs and k6 trace. last_message_ts: 1880012450
